output:
I finished the `--review-pr` checklist on `git diff facc006d2...HEAD`. The diff is two files: `useSessionExpiryGuard.ts` and its test. It makes three changes to the session-expired toast: it now shows only on workspaces routes, it is restyled from error to info and stays until dismissed, and its sign-in link is removed.

I checked all 48 rules from `rules.json`, and none fails outright. There are four minor findings (two are missing tests) and one product decision to confirm. I wrote the checklist to the scratchpad rather than `docs/engineering/`, and changed no tracked files. I didn't need to look up the review history behind any rule.

## Rules that applied

| Rule | Result | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| WEB-01 Hydration-aware auth effects | ✅ Pass | The effect still waits for `isHydrated`. Reading the route through a ref doesn't change the effect's dependencies, so it isn't re-armed. |
| WEB-02 Logout vs. session expiry | ✅ Pass | The `LOGGING_OUT_KEY` / OIDC suppression is unchanged. Auth is still cleared on every route. |
| WEB-03 Fresh probes for auth | ✅ Pass | The /me probe is untouched. |
| API-01 Removing public exports | ✅ Pass | `SESSION_EXPIRED_SIGN_IN_LABEL` was removed. Its only consumer was the test, which is updated. The hook itself is also used by `apps/web-tanstack/src/routes/__root.tsx:116`; its new `next/router` import is redirected there to the compat shim (`vite.config.ts:132`), so it still works. |
| WEB-04 Route matching | ⚠️ Minor | See finding 1. |
| TEST-01 Assertions fail on regression | ✅ Pass | The tests that expect no toast also check that auth was cleared, and tests in the same file check that the toast does appear. |
| TEST-02 New branches need tests | ⚠️ Minor | See findings 2 and 3. |
| CODE-05 Named membership checks | ✅ Pass | The rule targets chains of three or more `!==` checks. `isSpacesRoute` is already a named helper. |
| PROD-01 Product behavior changes | ❓ Confirm | See finding 5. |

The other 39 rules (feature boundaries, RTK, tx, chain, mobile, CI, E2E, numerics, security, and so on) don't touch this diff.

## Findings

1. **`apps/web/src/services/sessionExpiry/useSessionExpiryGuard.ts:23`** (WEB-04, minor)
   - The prefix check uses the hard-coded string `'/spaces/'`, while the other two comparisons on that line use `AppRoutes`.
   - The rule's example is `pathname === route || pathname.startsWith(route + '/')`.
   - Suggested form: `` pathname.startsWith(`${AppRoutes.spaces.index}/`) ``, so the check follows `AppRoutes` if the route ever changes.

2. **`apps/web/src/services/sessionExpiry/__tests__/useSessionExpiryGuard.test.tsx:317`** (TEST-02, minor)
   - No test covers the nested-route branch `pathname.startsWith('/spaces/')`. Only the exact `/spaces` and `/welcome/spaces` matches are tested.
   - If that branch were deleted, every test would still pass.
   - Fix: add a case with `AppRoutes.spaces.settings` (or another nested route) that expects the toast.

3. **`apps/web/src/services/sessionExpiry/useSessionExpiryGuard.ts:55-56`** (TEST-02, minor)
   - The ref exists so the route is read at the moment the timer fires, not when it was set. No test covers that.
   - Missing case: the timer is set on `/welcome/accounts`, the user moves to `/spaces`, the timer fires, and the toast should show.
   - Also untested: a /me 403 while outside a workspaces route (it should clear auth and show no toast).

4. **`apps/web/src/services/sessionExpiry/useSessionExpiryGuard.ts:22`** (DRY, minor; this one comes from the general principles in `AGENTS.md`, not from a `rules.json` rule)
   - `apps/web/src/features/spaces/hooks/useIsQualifiedSafe.ts:29` already has its own "is this a spaces route" check, and the two disagree.
   - That one matches with a bare `startsWith`, which also accepts paths like `/spaces-foo` and `/welcome/spaces/*`. The new helper matches exactly or with a trailing `/`.
   - Consider one shared helper, or at least note why they differ.

5. **`apps/web/src/services/sessionExpiry/useSessionExpiryGuard.ts:78-86`** (PROD-01, needs confirmation)
   - Several visible changes need a cited product or design decision:
     - The toast no longer shows outside workspaces routes.
     - The error styling is replaced by info.
     - The toast now stays until dismissed.
     - The "Sign in to workspaces" link is gone.
   - The commit messages say this is intended, but nothing in the diff points to the decision. Add it to the PR description.
   - One consequence to confirm: if the session expires on a non-workspaces page and the user then goes to `/welcome/spaces`, they're signed out with no toast explaining why.
